question: Can manifestation occur without reflective awareness of will?
premises: Reflective awareness of will proceeds in manifestation.
Knowers recognize reflective awareness as the nature of manifestation.
Without reflective awareness, manifestation would lack its own nature.
inference: Therefore manifestation necessarily includes reflective awareness and cannot occur without it.
plain_english: Reflective awareness of will does indeed proceed and is not absent from that. The wise know reflective awareness to be the very nature of manifestation; otherwise, manifestation would not be what it is.
